vintage: INSEE census 2023 and comparateur de territoires, geography 2026; historical population and housing series; 2017 and 2022 presidential elections, definitive second-round results; Terralyse DVF commune annual series, sales 2014–2025, millésime 2026; Météo-France SIM2 monthly reanalysis, 1961–2025; INSEE residential-migration principal indicators, census years 2012, 2017 and 2023

methodology.spatial_distribution: 1 km lattice over current commune polygons; uniform within each commune

lenses.name: Population history
lenses.description: Residents per km² in nine census snapshots from 1968 to 2023. Zero values clamp to the bottom of the log colour scale. INSEE comparateur commune values are distributed across current commune polygons on a 1 km lattice, assuming a uniform distribution inside each commune, with a centroid fallback for very small or sparsely sampled polygons; colour scales stay fixed across years. Overseas inset display areas are converted back to ground area using each territory's affine scale. Missing or suppressed commune values make the affected hexes null rather than zero.

lenses.name: Housing stock history
lenses.description: Total dwellings per km² in the 2012, 2017 and 2023 census snapshots. Zero values clamp to the bottom of the log colour scale. INSEE comparateur commune values are distributed across current commune polygons on a 1 km lattice, assuming a uniform distribution inside each commune, with a centroid fallback for very small or sparsely sampled polygons; colour scales stay fixed across years. Overseas inset display areas are converted back to ground area using each territory's affine scale. Missing or suppressed commune values make the affected hexes null rather than zero.

lenses.name: Homeownership history

INSEE comparateur commune values are distributed across current commune polygons on a 1 km lattice, assuming a uniform distribution inside each commune, with a centroid fallback for very small or sparsely sampled polygons; colour scales stay fixed across years. Overseas inset display areas are converted back to ground area using each territory's affine scale. Missing or suppressed commune values make the affected hexes null rather than zero.

INSEE comparateur commune values are distributed across current commune polygons on a 1 km lattice, assuming a uniform distribution inside each commune, with a centroid fallback for very small or sparsely sampled polygons; colour scales stay fixed across years. lenses.description: Vacant dwellings as a share of all dwellings in 2012, 2017 and 2023. INSEE comparateur commune values are distributed across current commune polygons on a 1 km lattice, assuming a uniform distribution inside each commune, with a centroid fallback for very small or sparsely sampled polygons; colour scales stay fixed across years. lenses.name: Le Pen vote history
lenses.description: Marine Le Pen's share of valid second-round votes in the 2017 and 2022 presidential elections. Definitive commune vote counts are summed to departments, then shown at every hex in the department. Both runoffs opposed Emmanuel Macron and Marine Le Pen, so vote shares are directly comparable; colour scales stay fixed across years.

lenses.name: Macron vote history
lenses.description: Emmanuel Macron's share of valid second-round votes in the 2017 and 2022 presidential elections. Definitive commune vote counts are summed to departments, then shown at every hex in the department. Both runoffs opposed Emmanuel Macron and Marine Le Pen, so vote shares are directly comparable; colour scales stay fixed across years.

lenses.name: Abstention history
lenses.description: Abstentions as a share of registered voters in the 2017 and 2022 presidential second rounds. Definitive commune vote counts are summed to departments, then shown at every hex in the department. Both runoffs opposed Emmanuel Macron and Marine Le Pen, so vote shares are directly comparable; colour scales stay fixed across years.

lenses.name: Housing-price history
lenses.description: Median sale price per m² of existing dwellings sold in each year from 2021 to 2025. Terralyse commune medians are distributed over current commune polygons on a 1 km lattice and combined as a transaction-count-weighted mean, not as a true hex-level median. Terralyse excludes new-build sales and dwellings outside its 20–500 m² and €1,000–50,000/m² filters, and does not publish a commune median below five sales. Hex estimates based on fewer than five spatially allocated sales are likewise suppressed. Sparse commune coverage reflects too few usable sales and is null rather than zero. DVF excludes Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte. Only 2021–2025 are exposed: pre-2021 rows include commune medians below the source's own €1,000/m² transaction floor, so they are not treated as the same measurement. Municipal-arrondissement detail for Paris, Lyon and Marseille is aggregated to parent communes; colour scales stay fixed across years.

lenses.name: Births history
lenses.description: Registered births per km² in each calendar year from 2016 to 2025. Counts are exact annual commune registrations distributed over current commune polygons; they are event densities rather than population rates because the commune extract does not publish annual population denominators. INSEE comparateur commune values are distributed across current commune polygons on a 1 km lattice, assuming a uniform distribution inside each commune, with a centroid fallback for very small or sparsely sampled polygons; colour scales stay fixed across years. Overseas inset display areas are converted back to ground area using each territory's affine scale. Missing or suppressed commune values make the affected hexes null rather than zero.

lenses.name: Deaths history
lenses.description: Registered deaths per km² in each calendar year from 2016 to 2025. Counts are exact annual commune registrations distributed over current commune polygons; they are event densities rather than population rates because the commune extract does not publish annual population denominators. INSEE comparateur commune values are distributed across current commune polygons on a 1 km lattice, assuming a uniform distribution inside each commune, with a centroid fallback for very small or sparsely sampled polygons; colour scales stay fixed across years. Overseas inset display areas are converted back to ground area using each territory's affine scale. Missing or suppressed commune values make the affected hexes null rather than zero.

lenses.name: Natural balance history
lenses.description: Registered births minus deaths per km² in each calendar year from 2016 to 2025. Negative values mean deaths exceeded births. Counts are exact annual commune registrations distributed over current commune polygons; they are event densities rather than population rates because the commune extract does not publish annual population denominators. INSEE comparateur commune values are distributed across current commune polygons on a 1 km lattice, assuming a uniform distribution inside each commune, with a centroid fallback for very small or sparsely sampled polygons; colour scales stay fixed across years. Overseas inset display areas are converted back to ground area using each territory's affine scale. Missing or suppressed commune values make the affected hexes null rather than zero.

lenses.name: Residential mobility history
lenses.description: Residents aged one year or more who lived in another commune one year earlier, as a share of all residents aged one year or more, in the 2012, 2017 and 2023 censuses. INSEE census-weighted commune counts are distributed across current commune polygons on a 1 km lattice, assuming uniform residence within each commune. These are gross one-year residential moves, not net migration balances. Missing or suppressed commune values make the affected hexes null rather than zero; the extract contains no Mayotte commune rows. Colour scales stay fixed across years.

lenses.name: Out-of-department in-migration history
lenses.description: Residents aged one year or more whose previous residence was outside their current department, including abroad or another overseas territory, as a share of all residents aged one year or more, in the 2012, 2017 and 2023 censuses. INSEE census-weighted commune counts are distributed across current commune polygons on a 1 km lattice, assuming uniform residence within each commune. These are gross one-year residential moves, not net migration balances. Missing or suppressed commune values make the affected hexes null rather than zero; the extract contains no Mayotte commune rows. Colour scales stay fixed across years.

lenses.name: Temperature history
lenses.description: Mean annual temperature in the 1985, 1995, 2005, 2015 and 2025 SIM2 reanalysis years. SIM2 reanalysis grid points are averaged inside each hex over metropolitan France. These are individual weather-year snapshots, not climate normals, so year-to-year variability is part of the measurement; overseas departments are outside SIM2 coverage. Colour scales stay fixed across years.

lenses.name: Rainfall history
lenses.description: Total annual precipitation in the 1985, 1995, 2005, 2015 and 2025 SIM2 reanalysis years. SIM2 reanalysis grid points are averaged inside each hex over metropolitan France. These are individual weather-year snapshots, not climate normals, so year-to-year variability is part of the measurement; overseas departments are outside SIM2 coverage. Colour scales stay fixed across years.

lenses.name: Water-deficit history
lenses.description: Annual potential evapotranspiration minus precipitation in the 1985, 1995, 2005, 2015 and 2025 SIM2 reanalysis years. Positive values indicate climatic moisture deficit before soil storage, irrigation, runoff and groundwater are considered. SIM2 reanalysis grid points are averaged inside each hex over metropolitan France. These are individual weather-year snapshots, not climate normals, so year-to-year variability is part of the measurement; overseas departments are outside SIM2 coverage. Colour scales stay fixed across years.
